title: Ordinary scalar restriction with section-normalized comparisons
statement:
Let $C_1\leftarrow C_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be arbitrary commutative rings and let $B$ be a commutative ring with compatible maps $\phi_n:B\to C_n$. For a scheme $X$, use the semilinear module-system category $\mathscr S_X$ of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations] and the constant-$B$ tower category $\mathcal T_X$ of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. There is an exact additive restriction functor $\rho_X^0:\mathscr S_X\to\mathcal T_X$, uniquely specified by $(\rho_X^0M)_n(H)=M_n(H)$ with $B$ action through $\phi_n$ and the original underlying transition maps. For every scheme map $f:X\to Y$ there are ordinary natural isomorphisms
$$b_f^0:\rho_X^0 f^*_{\bullet}\cong f_B^*\rho_Y^0,\qquad d_f^0:\rho_Y^0 f_{*,\bullet}\cong f_{*,B}\rho_X^0.$$
The direct-image comparison is identity on $M_n(H\times_YX)$; the inverse-image comparison and direct-image comparison preserve the specified adjunction unit and counit, so $d_f^0$ is the mate of $(b_f^0)^{-1}$. For an open $j:U\hookrightarrow X$, there is an isomorphism $a_j^0:\rho_X^0j_{!,\bullet}\cong j_{!,B}\rho_U^0$ normalized by the open units. Under these comparisons scalar restriction preserves the ordinary cartesian open comparison, the clopen projector, and hence the intrinsic ordinary $\alpha_Q$ of [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows], for every quasi-compact proper/open square. No coefficient flatness is required.
